title: An improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command vulnerability in the User API in Synology…
description: A vulnerability in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before versions 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers controlling a compromised LDAP or Active Directory server to exploit improper neutralization of special elements in SQL commands. This can lead to arbitrary file read/write and denial-of-service conditions.
